reviewed_baseline_note: null means no reviewed baseline exists yet. It never means unchanged. A baseline may be recorded only with an external binding: the Founder decision id that approved it and the merge commit that landed it.

proof_classes.name: semantic authority
proof_classes.proves: the content means what it should

authority_root: the GitHub review and merge record
an independent reviewer verdict on the complete diff at an exact head
validator_non_goals: judging whether a normative sentence is true
judging whether a mapping is semantically sound
standing in for a reviewer or a Founder decision
proving that a named test asserts what its name claims

prohibited_evasions: generating manifests, fixtures or rendered documents to stay under the handwritten limit
splitting content across files to duck the per-file cap
excluding anything but a lockfile from the total diff
surface_caps.on_exceed: split along a concept boundary; never redistribute lines

rules: one additional completed verdict round is permitted after a repair within the approved specification
the additional round reviews the exact new head
at most two completed verdicts; there is no third round
a specification gap still stops immediately and returns to the Founder
a no-verdict invocation consumes no completed round and is not retried automatically
a CLEAN or APPROVE verdict at the old head never carries to the new head

stop_rules.action: stop and return to the Founder, whatever budget remains; never patched in-round

stop_rules.trigger: budget exhausted with a blocker or high outstanding
stop_rules.action: hard stop, return to the Founder

merge_conditions: zero blocker and zero high, judged as the aggregate of unresolved findings on the tuple
every medium and low carries a named Founder disposition; there is no default
required checks green at the exact head

requirements: a named artifact that fails at the pre-fix commit, with command and observed failure
the same artifact passing at the fix commit, with command and observed result
a mutation control that removes or inverts the load-bearing mechanism, naming what it removed
every assertion resolves to an exact file, test or fixture
security_safe_evidence_forms: immutable digest of the restricted artifact
closure_contract.public_text_rule: public specification text, pull request bodies and reviewer briefs carry only safe characterisations and never restate a security payload, exploit input or reproduction script

reviewer_capacity.scope: one authority domain: one authoritative database and the host that owns it
reviewer_capacity.measured_in: actually in-flight invocations, not active claim records
reviewer_capacity.lost_owner: an invocation whose owner is lost keeps occupying capacity until proved terminal, cancellation confirmed, or a probe confirms it is not running
reviewer_capacity.no_probe_no_cancel: fails closed and holds capacity indefinitely
reviewer_capacity.independence: the reviewer is a principal distinct from the principal that produced the change

gates.evaluates: whether the constitution, every checkpoint and every implementation slice are complete
whether real provider implementation may begin
requires: each deferred decision answered by an approved resolution carrying an outcome, a content reference and a content version

non_waivable: one implementation pull request per lane

per_domain: Founder disposition of every finding, then Founder merge authorisation
the checkpoint pull request is merged and closed
only then may the implementation pull request for that domain open

asset_disposition_rules: reused material is reviewed again in the slice that reintroduces it; a prior review of a different pull request is not a review of this one
material classified HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_ONLY is never cited as evidence
effort already spent is not a reason to keep anything
provider_ordering_assumption: none; no provider identifier is assumed monotonically ordered, and any ordering model must cite an explicit published contract
